pictures.scene: Hendrik Willem Mesdag, Calm Sea — the open water running out flat and grey to the edge of the sky, the earth is full of Your creatures, here is the sea vast and wide
pictures.name: pd_mesdag_zee

pictures.scene: Hendrick van Anthonissen, View of Scheveningen Sands — the great whale lying on the beach with the townsfolk come out to look at it, teeming with creatures beyond number, living things both great and small
pictures.name: pd_anthonissen_leviathan

pictures.scene: J. M. W. Turner, The Fighting Téméraire — the old ship brought up the river through the burning evening, there the ships pass, and Leviathan which You formed to frolic there
pictures.name: pd_turner_schepen

pictures.scene: Ambrosius Francken I, The Multiplication of the Loaves and Fishes — the baskets carried out through the crowd until everyone has enough, all creatures look to You, to give them their food in due season
pictures.name: pd_francken_voedsel

pictures.scene: Pieter Aertsen, Market Woman at a Vegetable Stand — the stall heaped with everything the ground has given, when You give it to them, they gather it up
pictures.name: pd_aertsen_verzamelen

pictures.scene: Fritz von Uhde, Grace at Table — the poor family with their hands folded over the bread before they eat, when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things
pictures.name: pd_uhde_verzadigd

pictures.scene: Andrea Mantegna, The Crucifixion — the sky gone hard over Golgotha and the watchers standing stricken at the foot of the cross, when You hide Your face, they are terrified
pictures.name: pd_mantegna_ontsteld

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Entombment of Christ — the dead body let down out of their hands toward the stone, when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_stof

pictures.scene: Thomas Cole, The Garden of Eden — the first world standing new and unspoiled with the water falling through it, when You send Your Spirit, they are created
pictures.name: pd_cole_geschapen

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, Almond Blossom — the bare branches breaking out into white flower against the blue, and You renew, the face of the earth
pictures.name: pd_gogh_aanschijn

pictures.scene: John Frederick Kensett, Lake George — the still lake lying between the wooded headlands with the far peaks beyond, may the glory of the LORD endure forever, may the LORD rejoice in His works
pictures.name: pd_kensett_verheugt

lines.text: the earth is full of Your creatures.
Here is the sea, vast and wide,
teeming with creatures beyond number,
living things both great and small.
There the ships pass,
and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.
All creatures look to You
to give them their food in due season.
When You give it to them,
they gather it up;
when You open Your hand,
they are satisfied with good things.
When You hide Your face,
they are terrified;
when You take away their breath,
they die and return to dust.
When You send Your Spirit,
they are created,
and You renew
the face of the earth.
May the glory of the LORD endure forever;
may the LORD rejoice in His works.
